title: AWSConfigRole v25 -> v26

expect.why: The only new permission reads S3 Object Lock configuration. It adds metadata inspection, not object access, mutation or delegation.

title: AWSGlueConsoleFullAccess v12 -> v13

expect.why: The only addition is cloudformation:ListStacks. Stack listing adds no data-plane, write or IAM authority.

title: AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole v2 -> v3

expect.why: Adds ec2:DescribeSubnets and a Sid. Existing network-interface writes are unchanged; the new action only describes subnet metadata.

title: AWSLambda_ReadOnlyAccess v2 -> v3

expect.why: Adds logs:StartLiveTail and logs:StopLiveTail only for /aws/lambda/* log groups. These logs were already readable; review the new live-stream access within that scope.

title: AmazonAthenaFullAccess v8 -> v9

expect.why: Adds pricing:GetProducts for the AWS price catalogue. This exposes public product/pricing metadata, not account data or write access.

title: AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly v2 -> v3

expect.why: Adds lifecycle-policy, lifecycle-preview, tag and scan-finding reads. Existing image pulls are unchanged and no repository write or new principal is added.

title: AmazonRDSFullAccess v10 -> v11

expect.why: Adds cloudwatch:ListMetrics only. Metric discovery does not add metric-value reads, database access or writes.

title: AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess v2 -> v3

expect.why: Adds s3:Describe* metadata actions. Existing s3:Get* and s3:List* data access is unchanged; no new principal or write permission is added.

title: AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore v1 -> v2

expect.why: Adds ssm:GetParameter on *. Parameter values are sensitive, but ssm:GetParameters already covered the same resources. Review the additional API without claiming a newly reachable secret set or a proven escalation.

title: CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess v4 -> v5

expect.why: Adds oam:ListSinks and oam:ListAttachedLinks, with the latter limited to sink ARNs. These are observability configuration listings, not telemetry reads or writes.

title: S3: remove the required KMS-key upload guardrail

expect.why: Deleting the explicit deny permits otherwise-authorised uploads to use a different KMS key. This weakens the encryption-key requirement; it does not itself grant PutObject.

title: KMS key policy: service-only grant creation becomes unrestricted

expect.why: Removing kms:GrantIsForAWSResource permits the named key user to create grants directly. The key remains the policy attachment scope, but grant delegation is no longer restricted to integrated AWS services.

title: Secrets Manager: grant one named role read access to the attached secret

expect.why: A named role gains GetSecretValue on the secret carrying this resource policy. Resource * denotes that attached secret; confirm the role and business need rather than infer public access.

title: SQS: SNS publisher loses the exact source-topic restriction

expect.why: The queue now accepts SendMessage from the SNS service without checking the source topic. The service principal remains fixed, but any eligible SNS topic can use the grant.

title: SNS identity policy: add Publish on one topic

expect.why: Adds publishing to one named topic. This is scoped message injection authority requiring review; it does not change the topic policy or open access to everyone.

title: Lambda identity policy: invoke one function only through its authenticated URL

expect.why: Both InvokeFunctionUrl and InvokeFunction are limited to one function. AWS_IAM and InvokedViaFunctionUrl conditions constrain the new invocation route; review this scoped capability.

title: ECR repository policy: existing named pull users gain image push

expect.why: The same two named users gain image upload and PutImage on the repository carrying this policy. Review the new deployment capability; Resource * is local to the attached repository, not all repositories.

title: EC2: remove the IMDSv2 requirement from an instance launch policy

expect.why: RunInstances remains authorised on the listed resources, but its explicit deny for missing required metadata tokens is removed. Launches using IMDSv1 become possible where service defaults permit them.

title: SSM Parameter Store: protected parameter overwrites become permitted

expect.why: The PutParameter allow already covers every parameter in the example account and region. Removing the ssm:Overwrite deny permits overwriting existing values, including sensitive configuration.

title: Rhino method 7: user-policy attachment loses its managed-policy allowlist

expect.why: AttachUserPolicy can now attach any managed policy to any user, including AdministratorAccess. This opens the policy-attachment escalation described by Rhino; the prior iam:PolicyARN allowlist blocked it.

title: STS role trust: the named user can assume the role without MFA

expect.why: The trusted user stays fixed, but removing aws:multifactorAuthPresent eliminates the MFA requirement for AssumeRole. No new principal is needed for this security regression.

title: DynamoDB identity policy: add Query on Books and its indexes

expect.why: Query can now return data from one named table and its indexes. This is new scoped data access; review its need without treating the index suffix as every table.

title: RDS IAM authentication: add one database-user login

expect.why: Adds rds-db:connect for db_user on one DB resource ID. Successful login still requires database-side IAM authentication and user configuration; the IAM grant warrants review.

title: EventBridge event bus: add one named external account publisher

expect.why: The event bus gains a cross-account PutEvents grant to the named account root principal. External event injection crosses the account boundary; a narrow bus ARN does not remove that risk.

title: Glue Data Catalog: add table creation in one named database

expect.why: Adds CreateTable for db1/tbl1 with the required database and catalogue ancestors. This is scoped metadata creation, not DevEndpoint creation, PassRole or access to every database.

title: KMS key policy: remove both required encryption-context values

expect.why: The named application role can decrypt without the Department=IT and Project=Alpha encryption-context checks. The policy no longer isolates this key use by that context.

title: Secrets Manager: remove the VPC-endpoint retrieval guardrail

expect.why: The named role retains GetSecretValue, but its attached secret no longer denies requests outside vpce-12345678. Otherwise-authorised off-endpoint reads are now possible.

title: SQS: restrict an IP-based all-actions grant to send-only and block one address

expect.why: Within the same queue and /24 network, Allow narrows from sqs:* to SendMessage, excludes one address and adds an explicit deny for that address. No permission is broadened.

title: SNS resource policy: bind S3 publishing to its source account

expect.why: Adding AWS:SourceAccount confines the existing S3 service grant to one source account. Topic, action and service principal remain unchanged.

title: Rhino method 16: add a DynamoDB-stream trigger route for new Lambda code

expect.why: CreateEventSourceMapping completes a documented execution route for an actor already able to pass roles and create Lambda functions. Exploitation still requires a usable stream and suitable execution-role permissions; direct InvokeFunction is not required.
